contract.costs: This is not diffusive or full three-dimensional conductivity, finite-contact transport, a manufactured specimen or a room-temperature material result. Unlimited internal stiffness, scalar polarization and ideal interfaces are load-bearing in the theorem. Established inverse synthesis is credited; historical priority remains unknown.
contract.obstruction: Audit the proofs and test the predicted gain with a finite, measured structure under matched mass, stiffness, contact, polarization and material-loss resources.
contract.provides: Under fixed total cell mass and backbone spring, a positive lower bound on backbone mass, and ideal-contact one-dimensional scalar ballistic transport, the source reports a one-resonator realization minimizing the stated Bose-weighted conductance over its admitted finite passive internal networks. A later theorem reports a broader attainable-spectrum and inverse-design family. Finite connector/interface checks are separate model calculations.
